players.product: Power-secured HPC/AI data-center lease campuses (Lake Mariner NY for Fluidstack/Google; Justified & Muskie KY) - ex-Bitcoin-mining conversion

quarterly_data.signal: As of June 30, 2026 all of the Core42 leases and part of one Akela Fluidstack lease had commenced, comprising 81 critical IT MW of HPC lease capacity. The Justified Data Campus (Hawesville, Kentucky; more than 250 buildable acres with an on-site energized substation) has up to 480 MW of gross power availability, with construction expected to commence in 2026 and a phased buildout extending through 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 81 critical IT MW of HPC lease capacity commenced (as of June 30, 2026); Justified up to 480 MW gross power availability

connects_to.relationship: Lake Mariner (NY) HPC data-center lease tenant

contracts.signal: As of June 30, 2026 one of the Akela Fluidstack leases at Lake Mariner had partially commenced and the remaining leases are expected to commence in the second half of 2026 and in early 2027; the 378 MW under these leases represents the majority of the remaining contracted HPC capacity at Lake Mariner. The July 2026 amendments provide for commencement on a data hall-by-data hall basis, and for certain tenant-requested scope changes TeraWulf will receive additional base rent per kilowatt of tenant critical power from each data hall's commencement date, subject to annual escalation.
